purpose: Define the canonical ecosystem-ingress standing contract for both first-time establishment and subsequent access by already-established nodes, without making one host, one device class, or one processing destination authoritative.

umbrella_invariant.statement: Every covered ecosystem entry must cross the canonical ingress contract and either establish explicit genesis standing or prove continuity from an existing canonical predecessor. A downstream destination may not substitute for that determination.

ESTABLISH_GENESIS.meaning: Explicit first generation only; null is data, not a default.

VERIFY_EXISTING.meaning: Already-established standing continues only from validated predecessor lineage.

lineage_contract.rule: predecessor key MUST be present; null is permitted only for explicit generation-1 genesis; later generations require the SDK predecessor binding

classification_rule.note: An interaction may simultaneously be an established participant using a browser on a device through an ephemeral node. These dimensions are not mutually exclusive ingress classes.

canonical_ingress.continuation_policy: Map existing advertised surfaces before adding any endpoint.
must_publish: predecessor evidence required by each receiving boundary

authoritative_classification_requires: or validated previously established canonical node standing
binding of classification evidence to the canonical transition

boundary_lineage_requirement.known_review_finding: Current boundary receipt lane begins with previous_receipt_id null and does not yet express cross-lane predecessor standing.
boundary_lineage_requirement.repair_constraint: Reuse SDK lineage semantics; do not make receipt-chain previous_receipt_id a second definition of canonical predecessor.

receiving_boundary_must_validate: predecessor is admissible or explicit genesis
continuation is registered and not caller-substituted
manifest processing capability is bound to declared SDK route
receiving_boundary_must_reject: direct adapter request with absent predecessor key
message-content route selection outside manifest capability/route binding

device_os_distinction.authoritative_platform_distinction_requi: attested, registered, or otherwise non-caller-editable evidence bound to canonical standing

solution_map.solution: Remove optional lineage semantics and normatively reuse SDK predecessor contract; predecessor presence is mandatory and null is explicit genesis only.
Use heartbeat_epoch oscillator ordering only; wall-clock ordering is forbidden.
Require one canonical ingress contract, not one canonical host; deployment host is replaceable and non-authoritative.
Model framework/LLM as participant/consumer and surface/substrate/node/runtime as orthogonal dimensions.
Add VERIFY_EXISTING standing path driven by mandatory predecessor lineage; failed verification never silently becomes genesis.
Add BROWSER as an explicit interaction-surface dimension without assuming StegBrowser semantics until its owner is proven.
Retain NOT_PROVEN and FAIL_CLOSED; do not manufacture an attestation owner.
Require mapping to existing advertised surfaces before any new endpoint is created.
Require a canonical predecessor carrier/validation seam using SDK semantics; do not equate lane-local receipt chaining with cross-lane predecessor standing.
Mark noncompliant; receiving boundary must validate canonical standing before processing.
Forbid message-content processing selection; preserve manifest capability + route_id as the only processing selector.
Record ABSENT_FROM_CURRENT_TASK_REGISTRY_SCHEMA; do not invent COSV.

machine_readable_instructions.requirement: Discovery MUST publish both instruction profiles. Instructions are contract data, not authority, and MUST use existing canonical owners/surfaces.

steps: GET canonical node advertisement and health endpoint
establish explicit genesis standing or verify existing canonical predecessor standing
construct or retain canonical manifest whose processing.capability and processing.route_id bind an installed SDK route
submit through the existing LLM-adapter governed-manifest ingress/Interlock-InTr continuation
accept only the returned ALLOW, DENY, or FAIL_CLOSED disposition and retained evidence
GET canonical node advertisement and health endpoint
establish explicit genesis standing or verify existing canonical predecessor standing
use StegVerse-SDK stegverse.manifest_builder.build_manifest or the stegverse manifest build CLI to construct and validate the canonical manifest
for evaluator/governance framework submission use stegverse.external_framework_runner.manifest_external_framework_submission or stegverse external-run without --execute-enclosed
handoff through the existing SDK manifest state-transition/Interlock-InTr path to the registered receiving continuation
do not promote SDK-local handoff, enclosed validation, or unobserved far-side state into canonical completion
